diffAudit.methodologyNote: An initial raw sha256sum comparison of 'git show HEAD:<path>' output against the working-tree file for HSK1-5 falsely appeared to mismatch, due to this repository's core.autocrlf=true converting line endings on checkout but not on git show. This was corrected by using git's own object-hash comparison (git hash-object vs git rev-parse HEAD:<path>), which is authoritative and confirmed byte-for-byte identity for all five files.
